findings.title: Validate HTML inside choice branches instead of discarding them
findings.body: Normalization replaces entire MessageFormat choice expressions with "..." before checking HTML, including all branch text. For example, a quoted `second` branch in `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.seconds` passes verification because the link is never inspected. The resource is packaged unchanged, and MessageFormat restores that HTML when selecting the branch. Validate branch contents rather than exempting the whole expression, otherwise forbidden links and tags can bypass the new check.

findings.title: Preserve i18next interpolation in the React message bundles
findings.body: The account console uses i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`), not Java MessageFormat. Replacing these placeholders with single braces and adding `{2,choice,...}` means multivalued user-profile validation errors display the placeholders and choice expression literally instead of the attribute name and bounds. Retain frontend-compatible interpolation and pluralization here and in the corresponding changed admin-ui message.

findings.title: Restrict the anchor exemption to the actual a element
findings.body: `</?a[^>]*>` also matches elements such as `<audio>`, `<applet>`, and `<abbr>`. When verifying an English bundle, the reference value is the same string, so these tags and their attributes are removed as supposedly approved anchors before the sanitizer sees them. For example, `key=<audio autoplay src="https://example.com/audio"></audio>` returns no violations despite being outside the allowlist. Match the complete `a` tag name rather than any name beginning with `a`.

findings.title: Prevent the common prefix and suffix from overlapping
findings.body: The prefix and suffix scans are independent, so they can overlap when the sanitizer inserts closing tags. With an English message `key=`, sanitization produces ``: `start` becomes 3 and `end` becomes 2, causing `value.substring(3, 1)` to throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Malformed HTML then aborts verification instead of returning a useful violation and checking the remaining messages. Limit the suffix scan to the region left after removing the common prefix.

findings.title: Use Lithuanian text for the Lithuanian OTP setup instruction
findings.body: The replacement `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, not Lithuanian. The same Italian text was introduced for `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account bundle. Users selecting Lithuanian now receive the first OTP setup instruction in another language; replace both values with Lithuanian translations.

findings.title: Keep the zh_CN OTP instruction in Simplified Chinese
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value uses Traditional Chinese characters and terminology (`手機`, `安裝`, `應用程式`) in the Simplified Chinese `zh_CN` bundle. This changes the instruction to the wrong locale variant while the surrounding steps remain Simplified Chinese. Use a Simplified Chinese translation, as the login bundle's corresponding instruction already does.
